versions.changelog:
Initial release of the gen-release-notes skill.

- Generates professional release notes for git repositories based on changes since a given tag.
- Follows the Keep a Changelog and Semantic Versioning standards.
- Categorizes commits into Added, Changed, Deprecated, Removed, Fixed, and Security sections, focusing on user-visible changes only.
- Automates changelog footer link management, with hard gates to prevent missing or incorrect compare links.
- Excludes internal refactors, CI/CD, test, and style-only changes to keep notes relevant for users.
